# notes

A small, pre-existing notes service used as the brownfield target. FastAPI + stdlib sqlite3.

- `POST /notes` create a note with tags
- `GET /notes?tag=&limit=&after=` list notes oldest first, optionally filtered by tag. Paginated: `limit` defaults to 50 (max 200). When more notes exist the response carries an `X-Next-Cursor` header; pass it back as `after` to get the next page.
- `GET /notes/{id}` fetch one
- `DELETE /notes/{id}` delete one

Run tests with `pytest` from this directory.
